\begin{definition}[Polynomial-size verifier circuits]
\lean{Randomized.VerifierHasCircuits}
\statementsource{Vad12}{pdf-bf2ce5422088-p217-b003}
\statementsource{arora-barak-ch07-randomized-computation}{pdf-26d95080dbde-p013-b001}
\label{Randomized.VerifierHasCircuits}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.IsFaninTwo, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.IsWellFormed, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.eval, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.size}
Let $M$ be a Boolean-valued function of two finite Boolean lists, and let $p$ assign a
natural number to each input length. There are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that,
for every input length $n$ and every random-bit list $r$ of length $p(n)$, there is a
well-formed fan-in-two directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and size at most
$a(n+1)^k$ that computes $M(v,r)$ on every input $v\in\{0,1\}^n$, with $v$ supplied as a
list in its natural order.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Randomized to polynomial-size circuits]
\lean{Randomized.adleman}
\label{Randomized.adleman}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.IsFaninTwo, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.IsWellFormed, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.eval, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.size, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.mem_language_iff, Language.InPPoly, Randomized.ClosedUnderMajority, Randomized.InBPP, Randomized.VerifierHasCircuits, Randomized.boolVerifier, Randomized.bpp_error_reduction, Randomized.card_univ_bitstrings, Randomized.inBPPWeak_iff_inBPP, Randomized.polyLen, Randomized.randProb, Randomized.randProb_congr, Randomized.randProb_not}
\difficulty{6}
Let $E$ be a verifier model and let $L$ be a language of bit strings. If $E$ is closed
under majority, $L$ has an efficient verifier with two-thirds acceptance probability on
members and two-thirds rejection probability on nonmembers, and every efficient verifier
using polynomially many random bits has circuits of polynomial size computing its
verification predicate, then $L$ is decidable by a family of fan-in-two circuits of
polynomial size.
\end{theorem}
